clan_known_id.note: Known clan.* ID resolves one profile from the cold clan catalog. This static profile never substitutes for an active state/clan owner when current membership, leadership, facilities, resources, politics, access or training are consequential.

ambient_location_known_id.note: Static scene/travel location references only. Do not infer mutable inventory, staff, finances, security, damage, schedule, availability, ownership changes, or process state from this catalog; persistent mechanical state belongs in registered mutable authority.

strategic_place_known_id.note: Known place.* ID -> use owner prefix shard state/index/owners/place.json, then load only the exact state/place owner. Ambient ontology never substitutes for strategic mutable state.

environment_current.note: Current weather/light/ground conditions are a deterministic derived runtime authority keyed by exact campaign time, world seed and exact place country. This route never writes campaign state and never substitutes for mutable hazards, patrols, office hours, staffing, intelligence, chakra effects or technique rules.

population_recruitment.note: Recruitment stays aggregate for mass forces. Sword Manor creates one stable person core plus persistent individual-lite profile per accepted member; House cohort summaries are derived organization/training views.

mission_runtime_known_id.note: Known stable mission ID resolves one executable mission owner. Mission creation still requires verified issuer, participant, timing, and institutional authority; a typed gameplay command may mutate only an existing owner.

investigation_case_registry.note: Mission investigation cases are runtime-generated mutable truth. The caller may choose method, participants, assignments and elapsed work, but never a clue, culprit, hidden cause or result.

governance_occupation.note: Load the exact governance jurisdiction and referenced conflict/front occupation evidence. Occupation may establish military control basis but never silently transfers sovereignty, population, treasury, tax authority or loyalty.
